description: “Hok-oo” are given to a range of disturbances within the canopy, including eagles, the presence of neighbouring groups and, on a few occasions, to a flying squirrel. While producing these calls, males adopt a threat posture, combined with flashing their eyelids, sometimes combined with a short dash towards the disturbance.
